name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: A table for records people scan, compare, sort and select, with loading and empty states.

examples.name: data-table-demo
examples.title: Data table
examples.description: Sortable columns, status badges, end-aligned amounts and a pagination footer.

examples.name: data-table-sortable
examples.title: Sorting and sticky header
examples.description: Every column sorts; the header stays put while the body scrolls inside maxBlockSize.

examples.name: data-table-selection
examples.title: Selection with a toolbar
examples.description: Checkbox selection, search and a bulk action that reflects the selection.

examples.name: data-table-empty
examples.title: Empty
examples.description: An EmptyState in place of rows.

examples.name: data-table-loading
examples.title: Loading
examples.description: Skeleton rows while data loads; the grid is aria-busy.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the table. Or pass aria-labelledby pointing at a visible heading.

props.name: columns
props.description: { id, header, cell: (row) => ReactNode, isRowHeader?, allowsSorting?, align?: 'start' | 'end' | 'center', width?, minWidth?, textValue? }. Mark the column that names each row isRowHeader. Without an isRowHeader column, the first column becomes the row header.

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows to show, already sorted and paged.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: A stable, unique id per row. Used for selection keys and onRowAction.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Adds a checkbox column; multiple also adds select-all in the header.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Selected row ids (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Initially selected row ids (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with 'all' or a Set of row ids.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Row ids that can't be selected or actioned.

props.name: sortDescriptor
props.description: { column, direction } of the current sort (controlled). Sort rows yourself — see useSortedRows.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when a sortable header is pressed.

props.name: onRowAction
props.description: Called when a row is activated (click or Enter), e.g. to open its detail page.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows skeleton rows and sets aria-busy on the grid.

props.name: loadingRowCount
props.description: Skeleton rows while loading; match your page size to avoid a jump.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Visually hidden row-header text of each skeleton row, so rows are never announced with empty headers.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when rows is empty. Pass <EmptyState size="sm" …/> for a richer message.

props.name: density
props.description: Overrides the theme density for this table (row 48/36px).

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keeps the header visible while the body scrolls inside maxBlockSize.

props.name: maxBlockSize
props.description: Maximum height of the table's own scroll container.

props.name: className
props.description: Class for the outer scroll container.

props.name: rows, sortDescriptor, accessors
props.type: (rows: readonly T[], sort: DataTableSortDescriptor | undefined, accessors: Record<string, (row: T) => string | number | bigint | boolean | Date | null | undefined>) => T[]
props.description: Client-side sort. Locale-aware numeric string collation, dates and numbers by value, empty values last, stable ties. Define accessors outside the component.

props.name: children
props.description: Search, filters and actions. First child sits at the start, last at the end; wraps when narrow.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page, 1-based.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page.

props.name: totalCount
props.description: Total rows across all pages.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the new page.

props.name: formatSummary
props.type: (range: { start: number; end: number; total: number }) => ReactNode
props.description: Builds the range text (a polite live region).

props.name: landmark
props.description: Render the pager as a <nav> landmark. Off by default: table paging belongs to the table, so it is a labelled group and several tables can share a page. Turn on with a unique label.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the pager, e.g. "Payments pages".

keyboard.action: Moves focus into the table (to the last focused cell or row), then out of it.
Moves between rows, including up into the header row.
Moves between cells and column headers (mirrored in right-to-left).

keyboard.keys: Home / End, Page Up / Page Down
keyboard.action: Moves to the first / last cell in the row, or by a page of rows.

keyboard.keys: Enter / Space on a sortable header
keyboard.action: Sorts by that column; press again to reverse.
Toggles selection of the focused row (selectionMode single or multiple).
Performs onRowAction on the focused row.

notes: Renders role="grid" (a native <table>) named by aria-label or aria-labelledby; sortable headers expose aria-sort.
Mark the identifying column isRowHeader so screen readers announce it when moving between rows.
Row and select-all checkboxes are named by React Aria ("Select", "Select All"); the select-all box shows the indeterminate state.
Sort direction is shown with an arrow icon and aria-sort, not colour; unsorted sortable columns show a neutral up/down icon.

While loading, the grid is aria-busy="true"; skeleton rows are disabled, their placeholders are hidden, and each row header reads loadingLabel ("Loading") so no header is empty. Column headers stay visible.
The table scrolls sideways inside its own frame on narrow screens; the page never scrolls horizontally.
Selected rows use surface.selected, and hover does not darken them. Inside selected rows text.subtle is re-pointed to text.default so secondary text keeps AA on the tint.
DataTablePagination is a labelled group, not a landmark, by default, so several tables on one page never produce duplicate navigation landmarks.

do: End-align numbers and amounts (align: 'end') so digits line up.
Keep one column that names the row (isRowHeader) — usually a reference or name.
Show the result count and page with DataTablePagination; reset to page 1 when filters change.
Match loadingRowCount to the page size.
dont: Don't put more than one or two interactive controls in a row — use onRowAction to open detail.
Don't encode status with colour alone — use a Badge with a word.
Don't use a DataTable for page layout or for fewer than about three rows of simple data — use a list.
